services.name: Dental Bracing
services.description: Orthodontic dental braces align and straighten teeth, help position them with regard to a person's bite, and aim to improve dental health.

services.name: Teeth Cleaning
services.description: Routine professional prophylaxis removal of plaque, tartar, and surface stains to prevent cavities and periodontal disease.

services.name: Teeth Whitening
services.description: Cosmetic dental bleaching procedure to lighten teeth and remove discoloration for a brighter and cleaner smile.

services.name: Dental Implants & Restoration
services.description: Surgical placement of artificial tooth roots and crowns to replace missing or severely damaged teeth.
